T_solution:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

row = int(data[0][:-1])
seat = data[0][-1]

seconds = (row - 1) // 2 * 6 + (row - 1) // 2 + (row % 2) * 3
if seat == 'f':
    seconds += 1
elif seat == 'e':
    seconds += 2
elif seat == 'd':
    seconds += 3
elif seat == 'a':
    seconds += 4
elif seat == 'b':
    seconds += 5

print(seconds)

Problem: A new airplane SuperPuperJet has an infinite number of rows, numbered with positive integers starting with 1 from cockpit to tail. There are six seats in each row, denoted with letters from 'a' to 'f'. Each attendant first serves the passengers on the seats to the right of the aisle and then serves passengers on the seats to the left of the aisle (if one looks in the direction of the cockpit). -----Output-----

Print one integer — the number of seconds Vasya has to wait until he gets his lunch.

1

2d

Output
10

4a

11

Input
5e

18

-----Output-----

Print one integer — the number of seconds Vasya has to wait until he gets his lunch.

1f
